body:
ArenaBuildTemplate: named, ordered, possibly-partial item lists (Bruiser/Assassin/Caster presets, generic any-hero first pass). arena_hero_apply_build_template auto-buys as many as affordable in order (cheapest-first = the 'complex ordering rules'), stopping (not failing) at the first unaffordable item, skipping already-equipped items (idempotent re-click). Routes through a real compiled PARENA mod (stdlib/redgarden/build_template_mod.prn), same trigger/host-mutation split as bloodflower_mod.prn/tree_passive_mod.prn. New shop UI page (SHOP_BUILDS_PAGE) since apps/arena has no chat/command box (that's GFD-specific). Wire-synced (PACKET_ARENA_APPLY_BUILD_TEMPLATE). 7 new tests, live round-trip through the compiled mod. Wired into all 4 build paths (build.sh, build_arena.sh, test_arena.sh, ci.yml) up front -- learned from the tree-passive CI break earlier this session. Full 11-binary suite green. REDGARDEN 0da4ba3, PARENA 5db109f.

⚓ ☃
title: Build templates -- tech trees as item templates, shop auto-buy via PARENA mod
